title: Eh
text: Eh. Well, it was easy enough to assemble, except for the little bars that hold the taller items in. Those are impossible to put in properly. I would say this is an okay product except it didn't fit in my pantry. I have a narrower pantry and the depth of the little baskets knock against the door frame when I try to shut it. That's on me for not measuring! Overall this is a fine piece, but I personally would want something a little sturdier for the money.
